territories.name: Papua New Guinea
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Papua New Guinea levies a goods and services tax of its own under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003: the Internal Revenue Commission administers it at a rate of 10 per cent, exports and the other supplies of the return notes are zero-rated, health, education, gambling and financial services are exempt, and a registered person files a monthly return, form G1, by the 21st day of the following month.
